license: USGS ShakeMap data is public domain (USGS / US Government); OpenStreetMap data is licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL).
input_crs: EPSG:4326 (OpenStreetMap GeoJSON features and USGS ShakeMap grid)
output_crs: EPSG:4326 for GeoJSON outputs; EPSG 32637 used internally for area/length calculations
label_semantics: MMI (Modified Mercalli Intensity) sampled from USGS ShakeMap grid. For buildings, sampled at centroid with threshold mmi >= 7.0. For roads, max MMI sampled along vertices with threshold mmi >= 8.0.
flooded_attribute_definition: flooded = (mmi >= threshold), acting as an exposed-to-damaging-shaking proxy (not confirmed structural damage)
flood_extent_method: Derived from flagged exposed buildings (polygons) and flagged exposed roads (buffered by 5.0m), unioned and simplified in UTM.
area_length_method: Computed in UTM zone EPSG:32637 (local projected CRS), not in degrees
limitations: MMI is a modelled shaking intensity, not measured damage.
'flooded' flag means exposed-to-shaking proxy (hazard proxy, not confirmed damage).
Roads flagged by shaking are not confirmed blocked.
Single event: us6000jllz (Pazarcik earthquake, Kahramanmaras sequence, Feb 2023).
